content.comment_body: Hello, I experienced a similar issue when configuring email sending with my [product_name] communication module. After several attempts, I was able to successfully send emails by applying these settings: SMTP server: smtp.gmail.com, port: 587, encryption: STARTTLS (if available), my own email address (Gmail), password from my Gmail account. No CA certificate was loaded; I tried some certificates using OpenSSL but none were necessary. I made no changes to my firewall but did enable the 'Allow less secure applications' setting on my Google account. The test email was sent to another user account without a phone number. This approach worked for me without loading any certificates. Best regards, [user_name]

Closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'Unable to connect on my [product_name] using OpenVPN' appears in the [product_name] - Communication section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially faced challenges sending emails with the [product_name] communication module, but ultimately succeeded by using specified SMTP server settings and enabling 'Allow less secure applications' on their Google account. No certificate was needed, although certificates were tested. The thread was closed due to duplicate posting, not due to a technical solution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user looks for a straightforward email setup process with the [product_name] module, compatibility with common email services such as Gmail, and clear guidance about certificate requirements. Reliable connection and successful email delivery without extensive troubleshooting are also expected.
